_comment: Golden corpus for the two hostile-JSON validators: runner/internal/jsonvalue and the bridge's strictJSONParser in mcp/protocol.go. They enforce the same four rules on untrusted frames through completely different machinery — a hand-written byte scanner versus an encoding/json token stream — and the module boundary forbids sharing code, because mcp must stay stdlib-only. runner/internal/attest and mcp/internal/attest are kept honest by byte parity; these two cannot be, so they are kept honest by agreeing on this. Inputs are base64 so a case can carry bytes that are not valid UTF-8.
